shadows.name: sheet
shadows.purpose: The install sheet and dialogs over a scrim.

shadows.name: segment
shadows.purpose: The selected kind in Browse's filter.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Sheet rise and card lift on hover.

components.name: Get button
components.description: Opens the install sheet from any row.
components.css: .ds-get { min-width: 76px; height: 30px; border-radius: 15px; background: #EEEEF3; color: #0062CC; font: 700 15px system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; }

components.name: Free alternative tag
components.description: Only where the project says it replaces a paid tool.
components.css: .ds-alt { display: inline-block; font: 700 12px/1.2 system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 6px; background: rgba(36,138,61,.16); color: #1B6B31; }

components.name: Search field
components.description: One shared query across sidebar, home and Browse.
components.html: <input class="ds-search" type="search" placeholder="What do you want to do?">
components.css: .ds-search { width: 320px; border: 0; background: #EEEEF3; color: #000; border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 12px; font: 15px system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-search::placeholder { color: #636368; }

narrative.northStar: An app store everyone already knows how to use
narrative.overview: Skillshelf deliberately follows Apple's App Store and Mac App Store grammar so first-time visitors know how to use it. Its own marks are content: real maker pictures, plain-language lines, and a cited 'Free alternative to X' tag.

rules.name: Green means free
rules.body: Green tags only where data/alternatives.json cites the project.

rules.name: Risk colours stay in the details
rules.body: Orange and red appear only in Before you install and Technical details.

dos: Lead with what it does in plain words
donts: No tertiary grey for readable text
